Name: NoEasyFix
Description: Standard BattleMechs are finished machines: repair, re-armor, and swap gear that fits the stock layout, but leftover empty slots stay locked. OmniMechs keep leftover space. Type-change refits cost more; repairs and like-for-like swaps do not.
